draft.title: Why Europeans explored
card: From the 1400s, European powers sent ships across the oceans. Their rulers and merchants wanted to find new lands and new routes.
Trade and wealth
Spices, silk and gold were prized in Europe. Rulers wanted to buy them more cheaply, or to find them at the source, and so gain wealth.
Land and converts
Rulers also wanted new land to control. Many wanted to spread Christianity by winning converts, people who change to a new religion.
Better tools
Stronger ships could carry more cargo over long distances. Tools such as the compass and the astrolabe helped sailors find their way. These made long voyages possible. They did not cause the voyages.
draft.remember: Europeans explored for trade, wealth, land and converts, and better ships and tools made it possible.

a.q: Which of these was a reason European powers sent ships to explore from the 1400s?
opts: To find new sources of spices, silk and gold
To spread the compass to people who lacked it
To find new lands for sailors to hold as private farms
To test whether better ships could cross oceans
a.why: Rulers and merchants wanted wealth from trade, so they searched for goods at their source. The other options mix up the reasons with the tools. Ships and navigation tools made voyages possible, but they were not the purpose.
a.clue: Think about what rulers and merchants wanted to gain.

b.q: In the 1400s, a Portuguese ruler pays for a ship to sail along unknown coasts. His crew carries a compass and an astrolabe. What did these tools do?
opts: Helped sailors find their way on long voyages
Gave the ruler a reason to want new land
Made the ruler want to win converts abroad
Showed sailors where spices were grown
b.why: The compass and astrolabe helped sailors find their way, which made long voyages possible. They did not give rulers their reasons for exploring. Wealth, land and converts were the reasons, and the tools only helped carry them out.
b.clue: Ask whether a tool is a reason to go, or a help in getting there.

a.best: To find new sources of spices, silk and gold

b.best: Helped sailors find their way on long voyages

problems.detail: Why (a) says 'The other options mix up the reasons with the tools', but the option about sailors holding new lands as private farms has nothing to do with tools. It is wrong because the land was for rulers to control. The why does not explain that distractor.
